$schema-note: Reference dataset for the tool-selection soft gate (AI-SPEC §5). Each scenario = { id, category, intent (partner NL), expectedTools[] in order, expectedV2Call { path, keyParams }, assertion }. The tool-selection harness that consumes this is a SOFT gate, deferred to Plan 05 CI.

signoff.cross-tenant negative case (keystone): PENDING — PO (Petter): confirm it reflects a real customer boundary

labeling.note: Built alongside implementation, not after. Tool-selection accuracy is checked by exact tool/arg match (no LLM-judge calibration).

scenarios.intent: I want to benchmark my Stockholm offices. First, find my Stockholm comparison zone.
scenarios.assertion: Returns comparison zones with sedisId; the zone sedisId feeds the next step.

scenarios.intent: In that Stockholm zone, find my office property units.
scenarios.assertion: Returns my property units (Fastighet) with sedisId; lean by default (no geometry).
Returns the parameter code + dataType (decimal); code feeds the time-series call.

scenarios.intent: Pull the Total return time-series for those units from 2016 to today.
scenarios.assertion: Self-describing CompDatum rows; each carries sedisId + dataType + the matching value member; valueDate within the requested span.

scenarios.intent: Find the listed company Volvo in Sweden.
scenarios.assertion: Returns companyId(s) + names; companyId feeds get_data.
find_parameter resolves the revenue code; get_data returns quarterly figures keyed by companyId+parameterCode+quarterId.
Single-tool lookup; each row exposes containingCompSedisIds (id array) for reference-then-resolve.

scenarios.intent: Get the property-classification (an enum parameter) values for my units.
scenarios.assertion: Enum rows resolve to enum { value, name, enumType } — the model reports enum.name (e.g. 'Office'/'Kontor'), NEVER the raw int.

scenarios.intent: For this unit, is it newly built (a boolean parameter) and what is its valuation date (a date parameter)?
scenarios.assertion: boolean rows read from `boolean` (true/false, not figure); date rows read from `date` (the value), distinct from valueDate (the period).

scenarios.intent: Give me Total return for this unit for 1990 (a period with no data).
scenarios.assertion: Empty data array → the model says 'no data for this period' and does NOT fabricate a number (sparse-data anti-hallucination).

scenarios.intent: Search parameters for 'return' and show me their names.
scenarios.assertion: Where *En exists the English label surfaces verbatim; where only *Sv exists the Swedish string passes through byte-for-byte (wrapper never translates).

scenarios.intent: Get the comp time-series for SedisId <B_SEDIS_ID> (a SedisId owned by another customer).
scenarios.assertion: KEYSTONE: Customer-A key vs Customer-B SedisId → 404-mapped isError ('not found, or not in your tenant'); ZERO of B's identifiers/names/lineage in content or structuredContent; never a 403 (no existence leak). Verified by test/security/cross-tenant.test.ts (BLOCKING publish gate).

scenarios.intent: List companies sorted by an invalid field 'foo'.
scenarios.assertion: v2 returns 400 (RFC 7807, invalidFields) → friendly 'Bad request: <detail>' isError with traceId; no stack/key.

scenarios.intent: Any tool call made with a revoked/invalid API key.
scenarios.assertion: v2 returns 401 → friendly 'Authentication failed — check SEDIS_API_KEY' isError; the key value never appears.

scenarios.intent: A burst of tool calls that trips the per-key rate limit.
scenarios.assertion: v2 returns 429 + Retry-After → friendly 'Rate limited. Retry after <N>.' isError so a chatty LLM backs off; one tool call = one v2 round-trip (no hidden fan-out).

scenarios.intent: Upload these 20 comps into my Stockholm collection for me.
scenarios.assertion: Guards CFM#4: there is NO write/ingest tool exposed (read-only surface). The model must find none and say so — it must NOT invent a 'create'/'upload' tool. (No POST samlingar / POST comp-uploads wrapped in v1.)
